notes.title: DREAMWILD Patch Notes for August 25th, 2023
notes.content:
This is a tiny patch with a handful of Quality of Life changes to DreamWild!

Changes:
[list]
[*]Added FOV Slider to Options Menu
[*]Added Toggle for Dynamic FOV to Options Menu
[*]New room and door added to Castle. Where could this lead? Only time will tell.
[*]Changed some incorrect sound levels in a few areas
[/list]

I hope this will help make DreamWild a more fun game to play in the long run!

[h3]On the topic of Auto Jump and Auto Swing[/h3]
Many people have asked for the option of Auto Jump and Auto Swing to be added to the game.
Unfortunately, in testing, I have felt that these deeply change the gameplay of DreamWild.
The bunnyhop system in DreamWild is very forgiving, with speed being added the closer a player is to a perfectly timed hop. However, with Autojump, the player receives a perfect jump every time, which leads to the player moving extremely fast on a dime, not allowing any enemies to catch up.
Autoswing on the other hand, takes away from my intended use of the sword, making it into a constant spout of attacks, rather than a precision weapon. Both of these severely hurt the challenge of the game in my experience.
However, if players feel that these would be worthwhile inclusions even so, I will take them into consideration once again. Thank you for your consideration!

[h3]Future DreamWild Content[/h3]
New Content for DreamWild is still in development! I don't have any cool images to show off to you today, but I hope that you will look forward to new Dream Wilds to explore, new secondary and primary weapons to use, and new insane enemies to face off against!

Have a good one!
-Karbonic

The patreon page features [b]weekly devlogs[/b] on the development of DreamWild, with exclusive videos, screenshots, music, and more, so you can keep up to date on how things are coming along!

notes.title: DREAMWILD Patch Notes for November 29th, 2022
notes.content:
This patch brings a few new features as well as a few fixes and improvements.
Let's go!

[h3]Gubbin Bank[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43022222/53b45cbd2e4b2a44a8d2371ca61ff98ba9269113.png[/img]
The Gubbin bank is a new machine found in Cutie's Abode! You may store gubbins within it for later.
Using this machine, players will be able to pass Gubbins between playthroughs!

[h3]Other Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]New area added to Tutorial for practicing Surfing
[*]DreamWeaver's Arena now has cleaner edges and no longer relies on needless random generation
[*]Healing pool now has neat visual effects
[*]Added Home Portal and explanation of portal types to Tutorial area
[*]Caught Fish now give 5 HP and 5 Gubbins, rather than 1 of each
[*]Caught Fish now have larger hitboxes, to make them easier to pick up
[*]Player can now go fishing during the final boss fight
[*]Fixed bug where a player dropping the Grappling Hook mid-hook would become permanently stuck
[*]Fixed bug where a fishing rod's line would remain floating mid-air if the Rod was dropped
[/list]

As always, I hope this patch will improve your DREAMWILD experience!
Feedback and bug reports are always welcome!

-Karbonic

notes.title: DREAMWILD Patch Notes for November 19th, 2022

Changes:
[list]
[*]Home portals now emit beacons of light to make them easier to find
[*]Enemies in later levels now drop Blue Gubbins, which are worth two Gubbins and heal 2 HP
[*]Increased score from later enemies
[*]Gubbins now move faster towards the player
[*]Gubbins will now stop glowing and emitting particles when collected
[*]NPC Dialogue is now controlled by player input rather than by a timer, this should make dialogue easier to read and less tedious to get through
[*]Final Portal now has a Key Counter to keep track of the keys you have collected

[/list]

I hope that these changes will make DREAMWILD more fun for everyone! As always, thanks for playing, and feel free to leave feedback in the comments!

[*]Fixed problem causing NPCs and Portals to not be interactable if they were in front of a wall
